judge_notes: All three candidates agree that no behavioural assays qualify. This paper evaluates the performance of the Bruker PET/CT Si78 scanner. It uses NEMA phantoms, 22Na point sources, GATE simulations, and 18F-FDG PET imaging of four anaesthetised C57BL/6 mice.

No psychedelic compound was given. 18F-FDG is a radiotracer, and isoflurane was used only for anaesthesia. The only rodent work is PET/CT imaging, which the rubric excludes as an imaging-only readout. As a result, the assays and dosing lists are empty.

Study ID Moliner2026 is taken from the citation line 'Laura Moliner et al 2026 Phys. Med. Biol. 71 195009'. Strain C57BL/6 is taken from Methods section 2.5. Sex and age are not reported.
